summary: Short steep kerb on a residential street, with houses 11 m away on the same side.
reasons: Cars park nearby on the street

drivers.seclusion: Houses and units 11-20 m away on the same side; homes all round, so a van would be seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park along the street, but no overnight-van convention.

flags: Steep: about 8% grade, up to 11% at the south end
sun_shade: Open kerb; a large tree to the west gives some afternoon shade at the north end.

best_section.where: East kerb of Beatrice Street, beside the houses and units
